question.prompt: \(PA\) and \(PB\) are two tangents to circle \(O\), with points of tangency \(A\) and \(B\). Given \(\angle APB=60^\circ\) and \(PA=6\), find the length of \(AB\).

solutions.explanation: Since \(PA=PB\) and \(\angle APB=60^\circ\), \(\triangle PAB\) is equilateral, so \(AB=PA=6\).
solutions.title: Recognize an equilateral triangle
